result.summary: 本文提出了 Movie Gen，一组媒体生成基础模型，能够生成带同步音频的高质量 1080p 视频，并支持指令式视频编辑和基于用户图像的个性化视频生成 [abstract]。其最大的视频生成模型是 30B 参数的 Transformer，最大上下文长度为 73K 视频 token，对应 16 秒、16 FPS 的视频 [abstract]。模型在文本到视频、视频个性化、视频编辑、视频到音频和文本到音频等多个任务上取得了新的最优结果 [abstract]。作者还公开了两个基准 Movie Gen Video Bench 和 Movie Gen Audio Bench，并详细描述了模型架构、训练、推理和实验设置，希望加速媒体生成模型的研究 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文关注的核心科学挑战是让 AI 系统具备生成、组合和预测能力，并以图像、视频、音频作为输出空间 [S1.p1]。作者希望验证，通过同时扩展训练数据、计算量和模型参数，简单的基于 Transformer 和 Flow Matching 的模型能否成为高质量的媒体生成模型 [S1.p2]。此外，论文还希望为媒体生成模型提供可靠的评测基准，以加速该领域的研究与创新 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: Equipping AI systems with such generative, compositional, and prediction capabilities is a core scientific challenge with broad applications.
We find that scaling the training data, compute, and model parameters of a simple Transformer-based model trained with Flow Matching yields high quality generative models for video or audio.
To enable future benchmarking, we publicly release two benchmarks —Movie Gen Video Bench (Section 3.5.2), Movie Gen Audio Bench (Section 6.3.2).

method.text: Movie Gen 包含两个基础模型：30B 参数的 Movie Gen Video 用于联合文本到图像和文本到视频生成，13B 参数的 Movie Gen Audio 用于视频和文本到音频生成 [S2.p2]。视频模型在时空压缩的潜在空间中生成，使用时间自编码器（TAE）进行 8 倍时空压缩，并采用 Flow Matching 训练目标 [S3.p2][S3.SS1.SSS1.p1]。模型骨干基于 LLaMa3 架构，使用全双向注意力、交叉注意力文本条件和自适应层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS3.p3]。个性化通过后训练在参考图像条件下生成视频，编辑则通过多阶段训练在无监督视频编辑数据的情况下实现 [S2.p3]。

evidence.quote: We achieve these wide capabilities using two foundation models: • Movie Gen Video. A 30B parameter foundation model for joint text-to-image and text-to-video generation
We use the Flow Matching training objective to train our generative model.
we compress the input $8\times$ across each of the spatio-temporal dimensions
We build our Transformer backbone by closely following the Transformer block used in the LLaMa3 architecture.
We add video personalization and video editing capabilities to our foundation Movie Gen Video model via post-training procedures

experiments.text: 视频模型在约 1 亿视频-文本对和约 10 亿图像-文本对上预训练，并经过多阶段训练和高质量视频的监督微调 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1][S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]。评测使用人工 A/B 对比，覆盖文本对齐、视觉质量、真实感和美学等轴，并发布了包含 1003 个提示的 Movie Gen Video Bench [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1]。音频模型在约 100 万小时音频上预训练，并在电影级数据上微调，评测覆盖音频质量、视频对齐和文本对齐 [S2.p2][S6.SS3.p1]。编辑模型在 TGVE+ 和新提出的 Movie Gen Edit Bench 上评测，后者包含 1152 个示例、六种编辑任务 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Our pre-training dataset consists of $\mathcal{O}$ (100)M video-text pairs and $\mathcal{O}$ (1)B image-text pairs.
we publicly release a benchmark, Movie Gen Video Bench 1 1 1 https://github.com/facebookresearch/MovieGenBench, which consists of 1003 prompts
We pre-train the model on $\mathcal{O}$ (1)M hours of audio
the benchmark has altogether 1,152 examples, and spans six different editing tasks.

findings.text: Movie Gen Video 在整体质量上显著优于 Runway Gen3 和 LumaLabs，对 OpenAI Sora 有中等净胜，与 Kling1.5 持平 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。在真实感和美学上，Movie Gen Video 显著优于 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs 和 Kling1.5，并在真实感上显著优于 OpenAI Sora [S3.SS6.SSS1.p3]。个性化模型在身份保持、视频质量和文本对齐上大幅优于 ID-Animator [S4.SS5.p1]。编辑模型在 TGVE+ 上人类评估中比 EVE 被偏好超过 74% [S5.p3]。音频模型在音效、音乐和音频扩展任务上显著优于所有基线 [S6.SS4.SSS1.p3][S6.SS4.SSS1.p7]。

evidence.quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond $2\sigma$.
On realness and aesthetics, Movie Gen Video significantly outperforms Runway Gen3, LumaLabs and Kling1.5 on both metrics
our method significantly outperforms the baseline by a large margin in all axes of identity preservation, video quality, and text alignment.
human annotators prefer Movie Gen Edit more than 74% of the time when compared to the previous state-of-the-art on the TGVE+ benchmark.
Movie Gen Audio outperforms all baselines on all metrics by a large margin

limitations.text: 作者指出，视频生成模型在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理和状态变换等方面仍存在伪影 [S8.p2]。生成音频在动作密集、视觉上较小或被遮挡、或需要更细粒度视觉理解时有时会不同步，且由于设计选择目前不支持语音生成 [S8.p2]。作者还指出，使用人工评估定义客观标准仍然具有挑战性，评估可能受个人偏见等因素影响 [S8.p2]。此外，模型分别针对视频和音频训练，联合生成这些模态是重要的未来研究方向 [S8.p2]。

evidence.quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
Generated audio is sometimes out of synchronization when motions are dense ( e.g., tap dance), visually small or occluded ( e.g., footsteps)
It currently does not support voice generation either due to our design choices.

defining objective criteria evaluating model generations using human evaluations remains challenging and thus human evaluations can be influenced by a number of other factors such as personal biases, backgrounds etc.
While our models are trained separately for video and audio generation, developing models that can generate these modalities jointly is an important area of research.
